_: Batch 8a — a three-legged animal that stays three-legged (2026-10-14): batch 6a's recipe (BFL's fp8 klein, grown subject crop plus the detector's head, seeds 7 and 11) on three Commons tripods — the harlequin Great Dane and the holdout spaniel (front leg, standing) and the white dog (hind leg, lying). Two axes: the words (`listing`: "three-legged …" as in 6a; `count`: "with only three legs"; `which`: the missing leg named, as a listing that says so would) and the pose (the fixed three-quarter sit and stand of 6a, where 12 of 12 had four legs; the photo's own pose; an edit instruction that keeps the body as photographed). The orange cat is left out: sitting hides its missing hind leg. Never RescueGroups photos (ADR-0006 as amended 2026-08-25 §2).
